findings.rationale: The correction removes the false Joshua Bowen repetition record at 8,939,000-9,008,000 ms but does not preserve the actual later teammate contribution that the record purported to deduplicate. Events 3002-3029, 6,561,760-6,623,920 ms, contain Bowen's distinct Luke 17 premise: Jesus uses a slave who must continue serving, which Bowen says undercuts a New Testament condemnation of slavery. This is later than Matt Dillahunty's m09 and reaches the same team inference through a new textual premise. Under the team protocol it therefore needed either selection as an incremental contribution linked to m09 or an accurate excluded-repetition record with its real interval and rationale. Simply deleting the bad record hides rather than resolves the Q&A coverage/deduplication decision. The one authorized correction cycle is exhausted, so this remains unresolved and no further repair is authorized in this audit.

correctionHistory.summary: One bounded correction re-anchored m20 and m21, added one caption-exact quotation candidate per team, and removed two false repetition records. It resolved findings f01, f02, and f04, but did not fully resolve f03's Q&A coverage and team-deduplication requirement.
